image_prompt: A fifteen-year-old girl in cyberpunk anime style with an aristocratic bearing despite her youth. She has delicate, sharp facial features with high cheekbones and intelligent, piercing eyes that convey both cleverness and willful determination. Her hair is long and flowing, rendered in pale blonde or silver tones with luminescent cyberpunk accents, styled in an elaborate 18th-century fashion hybrid with futuristic holographic elements woven through the locks. Her slender, youthful frame is draped in an extravagant wedding gown that merges Baroque opulence with cyberpunk aesthetics—rich fabrics adorned with glowing neon trim, delicate lacework mixed with metallic threading, and subtle LED embellishments. Her expression radiates vibrant energy and spirited confidence beyond her years, with a hint of calculated charm. Fine jewelry adorns her neck and wrists, combining historical pearl and diamond pieces with sleek cyber-tech accents. Her posture is poised yet dynamic, suggesting both refined courtly training and restless, action-oriented vitality. The overall appearance balances fragile youth with commanding presence, marrying 18th-century nobility with futuristic anime sensibilities.
book_context: Catherine the Great: A Life (or similar biographical work on Catherine II)
